strings.zh: 我能感受到有股邪恶的力量{NEWLINE}侵犯了愤怒湖,但沉睡在湖中的精灵{CLEAR}一定会帮我们驱赶邪恶。
strings.en: I can feel an evil power invading{NEWLINE}the Lake of Rage. But the Pokémon{CLEAR}sleeping in the lake will surely{CLEAR}help us drive the evil away.

strings.zh: 原来前段时间{NEWLINE}愤怒湖的红色暴鲤龙事件,{CLEAR}是火箭队搞的鬼。{CLEAR}幸好有精灵联盟的冠军{CLEAR}带领一众训练家赶跑了火箭队。{CLEAR}如果湖中精灵有一天要离开这里,{CLEAR}那联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}这样的训练家,{CLEAR}一定是最适合它们的伙伴。
strings.en: So that red Gyarados business{NEWLINE}at the Lake of Rage a while{CLEAR}back was Team Rocket’s doing.{SCROLL}Luckily, the Pokémon League’s{NEWLINE}Champion led a bunch of Trainers{CLEAR}and drove Team Rocket off.{SCROLL}If the Pokémon in the{NEWLINE}lake ever leave this place, a Trainer{CLEAR}like League Champion {VAR:0103:0} would{CLEAR}surely be the best partner for them.

strings.zh: 我跟你说哦,在这个愤怒湖的湖底,{NEWLINE}居住着三只象征智慧、情感、意志的精灵,{CLEAR}你对这三只传说中的精灵感兴趣吗？
strings.en: Let me tell you something. At the{NEWLINE}bottom of this Lake of Rage live{CLEAR}three Pokémon that stand for{CLEAR}knowledge, emotion and willpower.{SCROLL}Are you interested in these{NEWLINE}three legendary Pokémon?

strings.zh: 是吗……那真是太遗憾了。
strings.en: I see... That’s a real shame.

strings.zh: 我就知道像你这样的训练家{NEWLINE}一定不会放过与传说中精灵{CLEAR}见面的机会。{CLEAR}但是要在愤怒湖遇到这三只精灵{CLEAR}也不是那么容易,{CLEAR}你必须先证明自己的{CLEAR}智慧、情感和意志才行。
strings.en: I knew a Trainer like you{NEWLINE}would never pass up a chance{CLEAR}to meet legendary Pokémon.{SCROLL}But meeting these three at{NEWLINE}the Lake of Rage isn’t so easy.{CLEAR}First you have to prove your{CLEAR}knowledge, emotion and willpower.

strings.zh: 下面我将给你出5道题,{NEWLINE}以考验你在口袋妖怪方面的智慧,{CLEAR}你准备好了吗？
strings.en: Now I’ll give you 5 questions{NEWLINE}to test your knowledge of{CLEAR}Pokémon. Are you ready?

strings.zh: 等你准备好了就来找我吧。
strings.en: Come see me when you’re ready.

strings.zh: 要在愤怒湖遇到这三只精灵{NEWLINE}并不是一件容易的事,{CLEAR}你必须先证明自己的{CLEAR}智慧、情感和意志才行。{SCROLL}下面我将给你出5道题,{NEWLINE}以考验你在口袋妖怪方面的智慧,{CLEAR}你准备好了吗？
strings.en: Meeting these three Pokémon{NEWLINE}at the Lake of Rage isn’t easy.{CLEAR}First you have to prove your{CLEAR}knowledge, emotion and willpower.{SCROLL}Now I’ll give you 5 questions{NEWLINE}to test your knowledge of{CLEAR}Pokémon. Are you ready?

strings.zh: 牧场里有猴怪、瓦斯弹、咩利羊{NEWLINE}三种精灵共10只,{CLEAR}通过计数后发现这些精灵{CLEAR}一共有26条腿。{CLEAR}请问牧场里瓦斯弹的数量可能是几？
strings.en: A ranch has 10 Pokémon in all:{NEWLINE}Mankey, Koffing and Mareep. Counting{CLEAR}them up, there are 26 legs in total.{SCROLL}How many Koffing could{NEWLINE}there be on the ranch?

strings.zh: 在口袋竞技的抢飞碟项目中,{NEWLINE}最后一排抢到飞碟{CLEAR}可以获得多少分？
strings.en: In the Pokéathlon’s Disc Catch{NEWLINE}event, how many points do you get{CLEAR}for catching a disc in the back row?

strings.zh: 战斗开始,{NEWLINE}对方首发加速特性的火焰鸡{CLEAR}连续使用两回合保护,{CLEAR}我方首发羊咩咩{CLEAR}连续使用两回合高速移动。{CLEAR}在同等级、零个体、无努力的情况下,{CLEAR}下列哪种情况的羊咩咩{CLEAR}在两回合后可以快过火焰鸡？
strings.en: The battle begins. The foe leads with a{NEWLINE}Blaziken with Speed Boost, which uses{CLEAR}Protect two turns in a row.{SCROLL}Your lead Flaaffy uses Agility two{NEWLINE}turns in a row.{SCROLL}Same level, zero IVs, no EVs. strings.en: Pikachu is to learn Tail Whip, Quick{NEWLINE}Attack, Protect and Thunderbolt.{CLEAR}How many possible orders{CLEAR}are there for learning them?

strings.zh: 真不愧是联盟冠军,{NEWLINE}居然答对了全部题目。{CLEAR}以你这样的聪明才智,{CLEAR}一定能在愤怒湖见到{CLEAR}代表智慧的黄色精灵。
strings.en: As expected of the League Champion.{NEWLINE}You got every question right!{SCROLL}With brains like yours, you’re{NEWLINE}sure to meet the yellow Pokémon{CLEAR}of knowledge at the Lake of Rage.

strings.zh: 刚刚的问题没有全部答对,{NEWLINE}这样是见不到象征智慧的黄色精灵的。
strings.en: You didn’t get all the questions right.{NEWLINE}You won’t meet the yellow Pokémon{CLEAR}that stands for knowledge like this.

strings.zh: 要见到象征情感的精灵,{NEWLINE}你必须与自己的精灵非常亲密才行,{CLEAR}你现在带着的精灵中,{CLEAR}有哪只精灵是跟你感情特别好的吗？
strings.en: To meet the Pokémon that stands{NEWLINE}for emotion, you have to be{CLEAR}very close to your own Pokémon.{SCROLL}Of the Pokémon you have with you, is{NEWLINE}there one you’re especially close to?

strings.zh: 没有的话就好好培养{NEWLINE}与精灵之间的感情吧。
strings.en: If not, work on building your{NEWLINE}bond with your Pokémon.

strings.zh: 哦？让我看看是哪只精灵。
strings.en: Oh? Let me see which Pokémon it is.

strings.zh: 这只是一颗蛋啊。
strings.en: This is just an Egg.

strings.zh: 你和这只精灵的感情还不够深厚,{NEWLINE}凭这样的羁绊无法见到湖中{CLEAR}代表情感的红色精灵。
strings.en: Your bond with this Pokémon isn’t{NEWLINE}deep enough yet. With a bond{CLEAR}like this, you can’t meet the red{CLEAR}Pokémon of emotion in the lake.

strings.zh: 我从这只精灵的眼神中就能感受到{NEWLINE}它对你那无以复加的信任和喜爱。{CLEAR}愤怒湖中代表情感的红色精灵{CLEAR}一定非常想要见到你这样的训练家。
strings.en: I can see in this Pokémon’s eyes how{NEWLINE}completely it trusts and loves you.{SCROLL}The red Pokémon of emotion{NEWLINE}in the Lake of Rage must really{CLEAR}want to meet a Trainer like you.

strings.zh: 如果想要向湖中的蓝色精灵{NEWLINE}证明自己的勇气,{CLEAR}最好的方法就是来一场精彩的对战。{SCROLL}虽然你身为联盟冠军,{NEWLINE}我肯定不是你的对手,{CLEAR}但这个展示勇气的过程{CLEAR}还是必不可少的。{CLEAR}你现在做好与我一战的准备了吗？
strings.en: If you want to prove your courage{NEWLINE}to the blue Pokémon in the lake,{CLEAR}the best way is a great battle.{SCROLL}You’re the League Champion, so I’m{NEWLINE}no match for you, but showing your{CLEAR}courage is a step you can’t skip.{SCROLL}Are you ready to battle me now?
strings.notes: zh uses 意志 (will) in #2/#4 and 勇气 (courage) in #41/#44 for the blue Pokémon (Azelf); kept as written.

strings.zh: 做好战斗准备后就来找我吧。
strings.en: Come see me once{NEWLINE}you’re ready to battle.

strings.zh: 这是向湖中精灵展示勇气的战斗,{NEWLINE}请尽全力攻过来吧！
strings.en: This battle is to show your courage{NEWLINE}to the Pokémon in the lake. Come{CLEAR}at me with everything you’ve got!

strings.zh: 这就是冠军的实力吗,{NEWLINE}真是太惊人了。{CLEAR}象征勇气的蓝色精灵{CLEAR}肯定会欣赏你这样天下无双的英雄。
strings.en: So this is a Champion’s{NEWLINE}power. Simply astonishing.{SCROLL}The blue Pokémon of courage is sure{NEWLINE}to admire a peerless hero like you.

strings.zh: 我们家族世世代代{NEWLINE}居住在这愤怒湖中,{CLEAR}守护着湖底精灵的秘密,{CLEAR}只为有一天能为它们找到合适的伙伴。{CLEAR}冠军大人你的出现,{CLEAR}让这个延续百年的使命{CLEAR}终于得到了完成。{SCROLL}谢谢你！
strings.en: For generations, my family has lived{NEWLINE}by the Lake of Rage, guarding the{CLEAR}secret of the Pokémon at the bottom{CLEAR}of the lake, all so that one day we{CLEAR}could find them the right partner.{SCROLL}With you here, Champion, our mission{NEWLINE}of a hundred years is finally complete.{SCROLL}Thank you!

strings.zh: 伦达『妈的,少耍滑头。{NEWLINE}快点交代关于湖中精灵的事！
strings.en: Petrel: Dammit, cut the{NEWLINE}crap. Spill everything about{CLEAR}the Pokémon in the lake!

strings.zh: 我们家族世代守护愤怒湖中的精灵,{NEWLINE}绝不会让你们火箭队这种坏人{CLEAR}染指他们的！
strings.en: My family has guarded the Pokémon{NEWLINE}in the Lake of Rage for generations.{CLEAR}We’ll never let crooks like Team{CLEAR}Rocket get their hands on them!

strings.zh: 伦达『操你妈的,{NEWLINE}老子可没耐心跟你废话,{CLEAR}等我一刀一刀刮你的时候,{CLEAR}看你说不说！
strings.en: Petrel: Fuck your mother! I don’t{NEWLINE}have the patience for your crap.{CLEAR}Let’s see if you talk once I start{CLEAR}carving you up one slice at a time!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『够了伦达！闭上你的脏嘴！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: That’s enough,{NEWLINE}Petrel! Shut your filthy mouth!

strings.zh: 伦达『妈的,你这狗冠军鼻子挺灵啊,{NEWLINE}这么快就跟来了。
strings.en: Petrel: Dammit, you Champion dog,{NEWLINE}you’ve got a good nose. Tracked me{CLEAR}down that fast.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我懒得跟你废话,{NEWLINE}今天既然让我在这里遇到了,{CLEAR}你们就束手就禽吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m not wasting words on you.{NEWLINE}Now that I’ve run into you here, you’d{CLEAR}all better come quietly!

strings.zh: 伦达『操,你嚣张个屁啊,老子跟你拼了！
strings.en: Petrel: Fuck, what are you so cocky{NEWLINE}about? I’ll fight you to the death!

strings.zh: 伦达『妈了个逼的,操！{NEWLINE}好汉不吃眼前亏,撤退！
strings.en: Petrel: Motherfucking fuck!{NEWLINE}A wise man doesn’t take a{CLEAR}beating he can dodge. Retreat!
{VAR:0103:0}: Running away? No chance!

strings.zh: 伦达『哈哈哈,你个臭傻逼,{NEWLINE}跑这么慢还想抓我？垃圾！
strings.en: Petrel: Hah hah hah! You stinking{NEWLINE}dumbfuck, you think you can catch{CLEAR}me running that slow? Trash!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『真是会逃跑……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: He really knows how to run...

strings.zh: 谢谢你在危难时候出手相救,{NEWLINE}你就是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}吧！{CLEAR}要不是最近收看了白银大会,{CLEAR}我都认不出你来。{SCROLL}我跟你说哦,在这个愤怒湖的湖底,{NEWLINE}居住着三只象征智慧、情感、意志的精灵,{CLEAR}如果湖中精灵有一天要离开这里,{CLEAR}那像你这样的训练家,{CLEAR}一定是最适合它们的伙伴。{SCROLL}如果你对这三只精灵感兴趣,{NEWLINE}随时可以来找我了解情况。
strings.en: Thank you for saving me when I{NEWLINE}was in danger. You’re League{CLEAR}Champion {VAR:0103:0}, aren’t you?{SCROLL}If I hadn’t been watching the{NEWLINE}Silver Conference lately, I{CLEAR}wouldn’t have recognized you.{SCROLL}Let me tell you something. At the{NEWLINE}bottom of this Lake of Rage live{CLEAR}three Pokémon that stand for{CLEAR}knowledge, emotion and willpower.{SCROLL}If the Pokémon in the lake ever leave{NEWLINE}this place, a Trainer like you would{CLEAR}surely be the best partner for them.{SCROLL}If you’re interested{NEWLINE}in these three Pokémon, come{CLEAR}see me anytime to learn more.
